mapper.update: UPDATE prd_requirement_acceptance SET implementation = #{implementation}, verdict = #{verdict}, note = #{note}, not_applicable_reason = #{notApplicableReason}, evidence_json = #{evidenceJson}, reported_at = #{reportedAt}, modifier_id = #{modifierId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dispatch_id = #{dispatchId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM prd_requirement_acceptance WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND workitem_id = #{workitemId}
